summary: Nokia filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine transfer of 216,896 treasury shares to participants of its equity-based incentive plans. The transfer was without consideration, based on a prior board resolution announced on October 2, 2025. Post-transfer, Nokia holds 132,136,437 own shares. This is a standard administrative share issuance for compensation purposes and does not constitute a special situation such as a tender offer, activist campaign, or capital return event. No special-situation event is identified.
